bio: Philip Miller, the husband of Frances Meier, was born at Hazleton in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, on 29 March 1859. He was living in Hazle Township in 1860 and in Hazleton in 1880. From 1900 he lived at Coal Dale in Rahn Township and then at Coaldale in Schuylkill County, where he died on 22 January 1940. He was buried at St. Joseph's Roman Catholic Cemetery in Summit Hill, Carbon County.
